newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal flat, short-dated deposits dip.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal flat, short-dated deposits dip.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal was steady against the dollar this week but some riyal interbank deposit rates lost 1/16 point in line with U.S. rates, dealers said.
"The market is very quiet. Some riyal rates dropped around 1/16 point in line with lower U.S. rates," one dealer said.
The spot riyal was unchanged at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.

One and three-month interbank deposit rates fell 1/16 point to 5-1/2, 3/8 percent and 5-5/8, 1/2 percent respectively. Six months were unchanged at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and one-year rates were put at six, 5-7/8 percent.
